نختلج (form VIII)
# نَخْتَلِجُ (naḵtaliju) /nax.ta.li.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَجَ (iḵtalaja)
# نَخْتَلِجَ (naḵtalija) /nax.ta.li.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَلَجَ (iḵtalaja)
# نَخْتَلِجْ (naḵtalij) /nax.ta.lid͡ʒ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْتَلَجَ (iḵtalaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
